body: 50 Cent speaks on the Drake/Kendrick beef and says Drake didn’t lose anything, despite what people were trying to make it seem like. 50 reveals he spoke to Drake and asked him what he felt he lost, and Drake replied, “Nothing,” which gets proven when he drops 3 albums in one night and they all start moving, showing he’s one of the strongest forces in music.
